description_en: We offer a 2+1+2 apartment for sale on Migjeni Boulevard, very close to the Astir roundabout. The apartment has a considerable investment. Total area 112 m2 net area 100.6 m2 It is organized in: - living room + separate kitchen - distribution corridor - two bedrooms (one of which turned into a high-quality personal gym) - two toilets - two balconies Located on the second floor of a well-managed building, with an elevator.
